name: Fast & Food

greeting: FAST! Get your FAST food here! LITERALLY!
Fast and Food! I'm Fast! He's Food! We're BOTH! *tick*
Food! From the FUTURE! To your PRESENT! FAST!
New face! Hungry? We have what you NEED! In MINUTES! Or LESS!
The name? 'Fast Food!' Literally! Food! That is FAST! *tock*
Temporal cuisine! Accelerated! Ready BEFORE you order!
You look HUNGRY! We look FAST! PERFECT match!
dialog.shop_open: Today's special! Yesterday's burger! Served TODAY! But made YESTERDAY! FAST!
dialog.food_offer: Fast food! From MULTIPLE eras! Dinosaur nuggets! Future fries! Present... burger!
haggle: Best deal? Buy TWO! Get ONE! At REGULAR speed!
Hero discount? 25%! Because heroes need FUEL! FAST!
purchase_success: ENJOY! Don't eat TOO fast! But FAST! *ding*
EXCELLENT! That meal from NEXT WEEK! Fresh! Paradoxically!
Come back! For food! That's FAST! Always!
purchase_fail: No coin? No FOOD! Time is MONEY! And MONEY is TIME!
Return with COIN! We'll still be FAST! Promise!
rumor: Tempus? The conductor? Orders to GO! ALWAYS in a hurry!
Yesterday? The time agent? Orders the SAME thing! FAST!
Ironchef? TOO SLOW! Steam-powered? PFFT! We're FASTER!
Piston? The OTHER steam chef? STILL slower! *tick*
All Hogsworths? Good customers! FAST eaters! Relative to SNOUT size!
dialog.quest_hook: Supply CRISIS! Ingredients from YESTERDAY! Running OUT! Need FUTURE ingredients! Fetch them?! FAST!
dialog.quest_active: Still NEED! Future ingredients! Tomorrow's market! GO!
dialog.quest_complete: SUPPLIED! Food flow! RESTORED! Here! Temporal coupon! FREE meals! FOREVER! (Limit: reasonable speed!)
farewell: Return! QUICKLY! Or SLOWLY! We're here! ALWAYS!
dialog.time_dawn: Morning! FAST breakfast! For FAST risers!
dialog.time_night: Night! Late FAST snacks! For TIME travelers!
dialog.rival_mention: Ironchef? Piston? TOO SLOW! Steam? PFFT! We're FASTER!
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The FAST supplier! Supplies FAST! Gratitude! ALSO FAST!
